ma.offNetworkStatusChange(function callback)

Cancel the listening for network status change events. If the parameter is empty, the listening to all events is canceled.

Parameter

function callback

Callback function for listening for network status change events.

Sample Code

<view>
  <button bindtap="onNetworkStatusChange">Start to monitor the network status change.</button>
  <button bindtap="offNetworkStatusChange">Canceling the Monitoring of Network Status Changes</button>
</view>

Page({
    listener(res) {
        console.log(res)
    },
    onNetworkStatusChange(){
        ma.onNetworkStatusChange(this.listener)
    },
    offNetworkStatusChange() {
        ma.offNetworkStatusChange(this.listener)
    },
});
